• Customer's final two turns contained deliberate recognition glitches ('address before' and partial name/address) that Max had to recover from by politely repeating the request
• Max repeated the maintenance-package explanation verbatim twice in a row instead of moving forward after the customer had already accepted
• After the customer clearly said they wanted the full package, Max still asked 'Which two of those do you see the most value in?' creating a minor disconnect
review.customerSentiment: Positive: Customer was engaged, affirmative throughout, and happy with the $4/day deal
